conservative.requirements: Play in response to dying effect: Play when you die. You do not die, instead. While this spell is recharging, you are alive and cannot be killed or KO’d by damage or injury. When the spell recharges, you die. This spell does not recharge following normal rules; instead, remove 1 recharge token from it each time you roll.
